title: af/survey-pending@1
description: One Survey the Surveyor is publishing (ADR-0152 clause 2): a machine-local file beside the Project Store's lock, `pending-surveys/<64 hex>.json`, never in the repository or the log. Written under the lock before the record's bytes go into the CAS, given the CAS object's identity once they are written, and removed once SurveyRecorded@1 committed; one that outlives its refresh names a record no event references. Canonical JSON, every number decimal text.

survey_id.description: The Survey: the CAS digest of its record's canonical bytes.

bytes.description: The length of the record's canonical bytes, 1 to 1048576.

object.description: The CAS object that holds the bytes, stated without following a link once they were written.
